title: Typed loader: @cacador/data exports questions, sections, topics and the manifest
description: Outcome: packages/data/src/index.ts gives the app and the scripts one typed way to read the data: the Question, Section, Topic, Translation and Hint types matching DESIGN.md § 3.3 and § 3.4; all 506 questions in id order; lookups by id, by section and by topic; the manifest; and the English translation and hint for an id when their files exist (undefined otherwise). It imports the JSON files statically so Vite and vitest both resolve them with no runtime file reading. Out of scope: any app code, any selection or weighting logic.
acceptance_criteria: In vitest, the package reports 506 questions, 262 in section biologia, 39 in topic patos, question 229 with image q229.jpg and answer C, and undefined for the English of any id since no translation file exists yet. tsc passes with strict settings and the types match the shapes in DESIGN.md § 3.3.
notes:
READ FIRST: DESIGN.md § 3.3 and § 3.4 (shapes) and § 6 (what the app will ask of the loader); packages/data/questions/08-biologia-patos.json as landed by .2; the exports field of /Users/ross.lote/Projects/personal/mathracer/mathracer/packages/core/package.json (Sumit's source-exporting workspace package, the pattern to copy).
TOUCHES: packages/data/src/** (new), packages/data/package.json (exports and typecheck only), packages/data/tsconfig.json
MODEL: sonnet (copies Sumit's source-exporting package pattern over fixed shapes)

title: Validator: the DESIGN.md § 4 rules, run by pnpm lint
description: Outcome: pnpm validate checks packages/data against the manifest with every rule in DESIGN.md § 4, in that order, failing on the first broken rule with the file and id named, and printing the counts (questions, files, sections, topics, images, questions with images) when all pass. pnpm lint runs it. Rules 5 and 6 apply only when translations, hints or the glossary exist, so today they pass trivially but are implemented and tested with fixtures. Out of scope: fixing data (that is the extractor's correction table), the loader.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm validate passes on the extracted data and prints 506 questions, 18 files, 11 sections, 29 topics, 15 images, 18 questions with an image. Each of the six rules in DESIGN.md § 4, and the manifest tiling check, has a fixture that makes it fail with a message naming the file and id, exercised by vitest. A manifest whose chunk ranges leave a gap fails before any question file is read. pnpm lint fails when pnpm validate fails.
notes:
READ FIRST: DESIGN.md § 4 (the rules), § 3.3 and § 3.4 (shapes); packages/data/manifest.json and one chunk file as landed by .1 and .2; packages/data/scripts/extract.mjs as landed by .2 (the manifest loading to share, not to copy).
TOUCHES: packages/data/scripts/validate.mjs, packages/data/scripts/**/*.test.*, packages/data/test/**, packages/data/package.json (the validate script line only), package.json (the lint line only)
MODEL: sonnet (the rules are enumerated; the job is to implement and fixture them)

title: Extractor: official PDF to 18 Portuguese chunk files and 15 image files
description: Outcome: pnpm extract rebuilds packages/data/questions/*.json and packages/data/images/* from packages/data/source/questionario-2016.pdf, deterministically, driven by the manifest. The script shells out to pdftotext and pdfimages (poppler) and handles every hazard in DESIGN.md § 2.2; a correction table inside the script holds any hand fix so a rerun reproduces it. Output follows the question shape in DESIGN.md § 3.3: single-line trimmed text, options keyed A B C, answer letter, section and topic from the manifest, image on exactly the 18 questions in § 2.3 (the sign is one file, sinal.jpg, shared by 373, 375, 394 and 397). Images are mapped by position as § 2.3 describes, not by a hand-typed list. Out of scope: validation rules (.3), the loader (.4), English.
acceptance_criteria: After pnpm extract: the 18 files of DESIGN.md § 3.1 exist with exactly their id ranges, 506 entries in all, every entry with three non-empty single-line options, an answer letter, no asterisk, no heading text, no double space; the 15 image files exist and are the pictures at the PDF positions in § 2.3; the 18 listed questions carry the right image name and no other question has one. Compared with source/reference-2026-05.json: the answer letter agrees on all 506; stems and options agree after collapsing whitespace on every question except 10, 58, 320, 361, 412, 415, 462, 474, 479, 498 (heading glued in the reference) and 411, 455 (hyphen artefact in the reference), where the new text is the clean one. Running pnpm extract a second time changes nothing. The script fails loudly, naming the page or question, when the PDF text does not parse into exactly 506 questions.
notes:
READ FIRST: DESIGN.md § 2 (structure, hazards, image table, reference parse), § 3.3 (shape), § 3.4 (manifest); packages/data/manifest.json as landed by .1. Check pdftotext and pdfimages are on PATH (brew install poppler) before starting; pdftohtml -xml gives image and text positions on a page and is how the image table in § 2.3 was built.
TOUCHES: packages/data/scripts/extract.mjs, packages/data/questions/**, packages/data/images/**, packages/data/package.json (the extract script line only), DESIGN.md § 2.2 (only to add a hazard found)
MODEL: sonnet (the hazards, the shape, the image positions and the expected output are all written down; the job is to follow them)

Mirror Sumit's root layout and tooling (DESIGN.md § 8): .nvmrc, packageManager, pnpm-workspace.yaml with minimumReleaseAge 4320 and no exclusions, eslint flat config, tsc per workspace, vitest, a root .gitignore for node_modules, dist and coverage. title: Phase 1: data package — workspace, manifest, extraction, images, validator, loader
description:
Pointer: DESIGN.md § 2 (source material and hazards), § 3 (data layout), § 4 (validation rules), § 5 (pipeline), § 8 (stack).

Scope in: the pnpm workspace with packages/data; the hand-maintained manifest; a deterministic extractor from the official PDF to 18 Portuguese chunk files and 15 image files; the validator wired into lint; a typed loader. Scope out: translations, glossary, hints, the web app (phases 2 to 4 in DESIGN.md § 5).
notes:
**DECISIONS** (epic-scoped log; durable record in DESIGN.md § 9, written in this planning session)
- Portuguese question files are generated by the extractor only; a hand fix goes into the extractor's correction table so a rerun reproduces it. DESIGN.md § 9, 2026-10-13.
- Chunk files follow DESIGN.md § 3.1 exactly: 18 files, none over 51 questions, none spanning a section, Biology split along species runs.
- Topics follow DESIGN.md § 3.2: per species inside Biology, the section slug elsewhere, assigned by id range from the manifest.
- The manifest is the hand-maintained spec (DESIGN.md § 3.4) and both scripts read it; nothing about chunks, topics or images is hard-coded in a script.
- Images are mapped by position in the PDF (DESIGN.md § 2.3): 14 species photos plus one sign shared by four questions, 15 files, 18 questions with an image.
- The earlier parse (DESIGN.md § 2.4) is a cross-check, never an input: its answers are right for all 506, its text is wrong on the ids listed in § 2.2.
- Stack mirrors Sumit with no server (DESIGN.md § 8); no pull requests, no walkthrough (user, 2026-10-13).

**SEQUENCING**
planned=4 beads in 0 groups, sonnet=3 opus=1.
.1 alone: it sets the workspace and writes the manifest the other three read. Then .2, then .3, then .4, one after another; this is a personal project and the beads share packages/data. Hazards: none named yet; `packages/data/manifest.json` is written by .1 and read by every later bead.

**ACCEPTANCE BAR**
Commands a person runs from a fresh clone, with what they see:
1. `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use && pnpm install && pnpm lint && pnpm test`: all green.
2. `ls packages/data/questions`: exactly the 18 files named in DESIGN.md § 3.1.
3. `pnpm extract` twice: the second run changes no file (`git status` clean).
4. `pnpm validate`: passes and prints the counts: 506 questions, 18 files, 11 sections, 29 topics, 15 images on 18 questions.
5. Open `packages/data/questions/08-biologia-patos.json`: 39 entries from id 228 to 266, entry 229 has `"image": "q229.jpg"`, `"answer": "C"`, and three options with no `*`.
6. Open `packages/data/questions/01-documentos.json`: entry 10's option C ends with "licença de aves aquáticas" and contains no heading text.
7. Break one entry by hand (set `"answer": "D"`) and run `pnpm validate`: it fails naming the file and id 10. Revert.
8. In a vitest run, `@cacador/data` loads 506 questions and reports 262 in section biologia and 39 in topic patos.

**CHANGE PROTOCOL**
- A new extraction hazard found while parsing: handle it in the extractor and add it to DESIGN.md § 2.2; a new validator rule goes into § 4. Both inside the bead that found it.
- Anything about English, glossary or hints: belongs to phase 2 or 3 (DESIGN.md § 5); file a bead there, do not add it here.
- Never widened inside a bead: the chunk table, the topic table, the manifest shape, the question shape.
- A wrong DECISION: record the reversal here and in DESIGN.md § 9 and carry on.

**DONE MEANS**
- `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` green from a fresh clone on Node 26.
- Every ACCEPTANCE BAR step above holds as written.
- `packages/data/questions/*.json` and `packages/data/images/*` are committed and a rerun of `pnpm extract` leaves no diff.
- DESIGN.md § 2.2 and § 4 reflect any hazard or rule a bead added.
- `.beads/issues.jsonl` is committed with the closing commit of each bead.

**RUN RECORD**
chosen by orchestrator, reversible: each manifest section carries `heading`, the exact all-caps PDF heading, over hard-coding the eleven headings in extract.mjs and validate.mjs because both scripts need them and DECISIONS keep section facts in the manifest. DESIGN.md § 3.4 updated in the cac-eo6.1 commit.
